head.t: Enrolment completed in study of Freesolve resorbable magnesium scaffold
head.x: Teleflex Incorporated has announced the successful completion of patient enrolment in the BIOMAG-LL clinical study, evaluating the safety and clinical performance of the Freesolve resorbable magnesium scaffold (RMS) in 35mm and 40mm lengths for the treatment of de novo coronary lesions up to 38mm.
